role.zh: GitOrg Atlas 维护者，长期实战 Git 工作流与代码评审
role.en: Maintainer of GitOrg Atlas. Long-running practitioner of Git workflows and code review.

bio.zh: 在多家技术团队负责代码评审流程与 Git 工作流落地，处理过大型仓库的迁移、历史重写、合并冲突复盘与 CI/CD 集成。GitOrg Atlas 的内容来自这些真实场景，包含演练用例和恢复路径。
bio.en: Has led code-review processes and Git workflow rollouts across multiple engineering teams, including large-repo migrations, history rewriting, conflict post-mortems, and CI/CD integration. The content on GitOrg Atlas is sourced from those real situations, with reproducible examples and recovery playbooks.
